newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Moody's assigns ratings to Slovenia's NLB.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns ratings to Slovenia's NLB.

text.p: Moody's Investor Services said on Wednesday it was assigning Slovenia's Nova Ljubljanska Banka (NLB) a Baa3 rating for long-term foreign currency deposits and Prime-3 for short-term deposits.

The credit rating agency said the ratings were based on the bank's strong position in the Slovenian market, its improved profitability, and declining level of problem loans. NLB is Slovenia's largest bank and is state owned.
The bank is expected to be privatised this year.
Moody's also assigned a D+ for the bank's financial strength.

"The ratings also reflect the bank's moderate liquidity and dependence on wholesale funding, its high level of fixed assets and capital investments relative to equity, and the transitional nature of the Slovenian banking market," it said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
